agcRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Two Block II guidance computers.
Command Module entry programs
are not Lunar Module landing
programs.

p27Requirement.label:
«requirement»
P27 accepts verbs V70 through
V73 only. That path is not
the ground CCATS uplink.

cmEcsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Command Module cabin is five
pounds per square inch of
oxygen. The specification is
three crew for fourteen days.

a11AtypicalRequirement.label:
«requirement»
This instance is atypical:
control room two, cryogenic
tankage two plus two, P66
landing, sourced ropes.

usbCsmRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Command/Service Module Unified
S-Band uses the sourced uplink
and the two sourced downlinks.
Rates stay in the Press Kit.

usbLmRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Lunar Module Unified S-Band
uses a different frequency
pair. Phase and frequency
modulation do not run together.

rsoRequirement.label:
«requirement»
The Range Safety Officer sits
outside Mission Control Center.
Destruct is ultra-high frequency
and is safed after Earth orbit.

a7lRequirement.label:
«requirement»
The A7L pressure garment holds
a sourced suit differential.
Portable life-support oxygen
and heat loads stay cited.

a11MassRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Serials and Press Kit tank loads
are documentation, not a
required-mass shall. Propellant
load and lunar Δv stay unmarked.

scsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Stabilization and Control is
the analog backup. The crew
selects between the guidance
computer and that analog path.

pngsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Primary Guidance, Navigation,
and Control is not Abort
Guidance. The computer, inertial
unit, and radars belong to it.

eclssLoopRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Life support supplies oxygen,
water, and lithium hydroxide.
Cabin carbon dioxide stays at
or below the sourced limit.

epsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Electrical power is three
Service Module fuel cells plus
silver-zinc batteries. There is
no stage-to-stage power.

agsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Abort Guidance is the electronics
assembly, sensor assembly, and
data-entry display. It is not
a landing computer.

dockingRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Docking is Command Module probe
to Lunar Module drogue, then
twelve ring latches. Soft dock
precedes hard dock.

rcsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Service Module and Lunar Module
reaction-control engines share
one sourced thrust. Command
Module engines use another.

spsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Service Propulsion System
sources disagree on vacuum
thrust. There is no required
thrust and no loaded-mass
requirement.

dpsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Descent Propulsion System
sources disagree on thrust
and throttle. There is no
required thrust.

pipaRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Pulse Integrating Pendulous
Accelerometer scale differs
between Command Module and
Lunar Module.

vhfRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Very High Frequency voice uses
two sourced channels. Recovery
uses the sourced guard
frequency.

isolationRequirement.label:
«requirement»
There is no stage-to-stage
electrical power. There is no
Command/Service Module to Lunar
Module propellant crossfeed.

recoveryRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Splash is the flown Ground
Elapsed Time from the Mission
Report. Distance is from the
recovery ship, not the target.

kscRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Kennedy Space Center Launch
Control owns commit from Firing
Room 1. Voice hands to Mission
Control at tower clear.

lm5ConsumableRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Lunar Module descent oxygen is
a teaching figure. Another
technical note prints a different
tank pressure. There is no
required pressure.

apsRequirement.label:
«requirement»
Ascent Propulsion System thrust,
rise time, and cant stay as the
cited experience report states
them.
